info.name: Auth Service
info.description: Auth Service (port 8081): sign-in, token refresh and logout, user management. Contract: project_docs/modules/auth.md. Login, Change Password and Refresh save the access token to `authToken` and the refresh token to `refreshToken`; the same access token is used by the Directory collection.

exec: // Токены сохраняются только из ответа, где они есть: отказ и ответ без сессии их не затирают.
console.log("Password change required: call Change Password");

request.description: Authenticates a user and returns a signed JWT access token plus an opaque refresh token; the `test` script saves them to `authToken` and `refreshToken`. `expiresIn` (seconds) mirrors JWT_EXPIRATION_MS (15 minutes by default); `refreshExpiresIn` mirrors AUTH_REFRESH_TTL (20 minutes, sliding). If the password was set by someone else (user creation, a reset by another user, the bootstrap) the answer is 200 with passwordChangeRequired=true and no tokens (PCI DSS 8.3.5, Р-100): call Change Password to get a session. Refusals: 400 "Invalid username or password" (unknown login and wrong password answer the same); with the right password, 400 "Account is locked due to multiple failed login attempts. Please try again in N minutes." (6 wrong passwords in a row lock the account for 30 minutes) or 400 "Account is not active. Please contact your administrator."; 429 "Too many login attempts. Please try again later." with Retry-After after 10 failures from one address within 15 minutes.

exec: // Токены сохраняются только из ответа, где они есть: отказ и ответ без сессии их не затирают.
console.log("Password change required: call Change Password");

request.description: Changes the password by the current one and signs in with the new one (PCI DSS 8.3.5, Р-100). Public, like Login: the same address limit, account lockout and status checks apply; a wrong current password is 400 and counts as a failed attempt. The new password follows the same policy as on user creation and must not repeat any of the last 4 passwords (PCI DSS 8.3.7, Р-102). Returns the same body as Login, with passwordChangeRequired=false; the other sessions of the user are revoked.

Rotates the refresh token: returns a new access token and a NEW refresh token in the same family; the presented one is retired. Public — no Authorization header needed. Any refusal is 401 "Invalid refresh token": unknown, expired, revoked, reused after the 10 s grace window (revokes the whole family and logs REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSE), the user is not ACTIVE, or the user must change the password first (Р-100) — the last two revoke the family too. A missing refreshToken is 400. Send it twice quickly to see the grace window (both succeed); wait >10 s and send the OLD token again to see reuse detection kill the family.

exec: console.log("Rotated: new authToken and refreshToken saved");

request.description: Ends the session: revokes the whole refresh-token family. 204 for a live, unknown or empty token alike (the endpoint is deliberately not an oracle). The access token is not revoked: it stays valid until it expires, 15 minutes by default (JWT_EXPIRATION_MS) — there is no blacklist.

body.raw:
{
  "username": "head@company.com",
  "password": "<NEW_USER_PASSWORD: 12+ chars, A-Z, a-z, 0-9, special>",
  "fullName": "Company Head User",
  "role": "COMPANY_HEAD",
  "companyId": "comp-01"
}

request.description: Creates a user (201). A COMPANY_EMPLOYEE needs terminalIds - at least one terminal of its company (400 "An employee needs at least one terminal" / "Terminals [..] do not belong to company .."); other roles take none (400 "Terminals are assigned to employees only"), Р-131. SYSTEM_ADMIN: any role, any company. COMPANY_HEAD: its own company only and roles COMPANY_MANAGER and COMPANY_EMPLOYEE only (403 "Cannot create user for another company" / "Cannot assign this role"). A company role (COMPANY_HEAD, COMPANY_MANAGER, COMPANY_EMPLOYEE) requires companyId (400 "Role <ROLE> requires a company"); SYSTEM_ADMIN and AUDITOR may go without one. Password policy: at least 12 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a special character. The new user changes the password at first sign-in (passwordChangeRequired=true, Р-100). A taken login — 400 "Username already exists", an unknown company — 400 "Company not found". The returned id is saved to the `userId` collection variable.
Retrieves the user in `userId`. SYSTEM_ADMIN: any user; COMPANY_HEAD: users of its own company. An unknown or deleted user — 400 "User not found"; anything else not allowed — 403 "Access denied".

query.description: P3-1: подстрока без учёта регистра по username, fullName, companyId и названию компании; % и _ ищутся буквально; пустая строка = нет фильтра
P3-1: точное значение роли (регистр не важен); неизвестная роль = нет фильтра, не 400

request.description: Retrieves one page of users (P2-1): a PagedResponse — {content, totalElements, totalPages, size, number}. page defaults to 0, size to 20, ceiling 200; out-of-range values are clamped, not rejected. Ordered by username, then id. Soft-deleted accounts are excluded from both content and totalElements. SYSTEM_ADMIN sees everyone, COMPANY_HEAD only its own company (a head without a company gets an empty page), other roles — 403.

Partially updates a user: null or absent fields are not changed. terminalIds replaces the employee's terminals as a whole; checked only when terminals, role or company change - becoming an employee or moving to another company needs terminals of that company in the same request, leaving the employee role drops them (Р-131). SYSTEM_ADMIN: any user; COMPANY_HEAD: itself and COMPANY_MANAGER / COMPANY_EMPLOYEE of its own company, granting only those two roles (Р-85). status is ACTIVE or BLOCKED only (400 "User status must be ACTIVE or BLOCKED"); BLOCKED revokes the user's refresh tokens at once, ACTIVE restarts the 90-day inactivity count (Р-101). A password set for someone else must be changed at their next sign-in and revokes their sessions (Р-100); one's own new password must not repeat the last 4 (Р-102). New role and company take effect at the next refresh. companyId — see Move User To Company.

Р-90: перевод пользователя в другую компанию и смена роли одним запросом. companyId меняет только SYSTEM_ADMIN; пустая строка снимает компанию — только вместе с ролью вне компании (SYSTEM_ADMIN, AUDITOR). Роль компании без компании — 400, несуществующая компания — 400, попытка руководителя — 403.
Soft delete (204): status becomes DELETED and every refresh token of the user is revoked. Same access rules as Update User. An unknown user — 400 "User not found".
